name: kelp
notes: kelp: Giant kelp: stipes rising from a holdfast on the reef to the surface, blades all the way up and a floating canopy. Grows only under 3 to 16 m of sea; height is the share of that depth (at high water) the stipe reaches; the rest of its length lies along the surface and gets longer as the tide goes out. Loose strands, not voxels, so swimmers pass through.
